Discovery Domain · уровень 6

You can now activate your Drowned Breath by expending a use of Channel Divinity when a creature fails a saving throw against one of your spells.
In addition, a creature affected by Drowned Breath cannot cast spells requiring a Verbal component.

Автоматизация / ограничения:

  • Пассивное/сюжетное правило: описание сохранено; применение по тексту.
